correctness.rationale: The complete mask polynomial factorization gives exactly one nonsingular positive analytic oval and one isolated quadratic torus zero. The cyclotomic separation lemma is proved using real 2·3^h cyclotomic subfields and an odd-order Galois automorphism and excludes all scaled oval/lattice collisions, not just finitely many. Exactly r=min(v_3(u),v_3(v))+1 quadratic mask zeros occur at each isolated lattice frequency; their uniform definite quadratic leading term and nonvanishing analytic product tail prove exact order 2r and winding zero. Nested 3-adic sublattices prove exact shell counts, density 8/9^r and multiplicity-weighted coefficient π/4. The actual checker performed 80 exact small-conductor cyclotomic gcd exclusions, eight high-precision local tests, and three direct finite lattice enumerations. Finite tests are corroboration only.

originality.rationale: The full primary texts inspected cover general affine-IFS Fourier masks (Dutkay and Jorgensen 2006) and a different prime-cardinality Sierpinski-type Moran digit family (Chen and Yan 2025), not the eight-digit carpet with a continuous mask oval plus an isolated double point. Earlier three-digit dyadic gasket zero censuses have discrete two-point mask zeros and do not imply an eight-digit ternary carpet mixed-dimensional locus or its all-order isolated-zero count. The statement was searched under direct mask, cyclotomic, nodal and shifted-lattice formulations, with no covering item identified. This is a qualified originality judgment, not an assertion of independent historical priority.

value.rationale: The uniform planar eight-digit carpet is a canonical self-similar singular probability measure and its real Fourier zeros control exponential orthogonality and diffraction. The naturally mixed mask geometry produces both continuous zero curves and isolated quadratic points. The nonobvious cyclotomic separation lemma completely separates these features at all ternary scales, permitting the exact geometric order distribution of every isolated Fourier zero. Arbitrarily high even Taylor multiplicity combined with vanishing local phase winding is a structural result, not a routine finite test or arbitrary parameter slice.
